openings.title: Openings
openings.intro: We are looking for self-motivated students and collaborators interested in computer vision, visual quality assessment, and efficient AI.

positions.name: PhD Students
positions.details: Applicants with strong background in machine learning/computer vision are welcome.

positions.name: Research Interns
positions.details: Remote or on-site internships are available for students with publication goals.

positions.name: Visiting Students
positions.details: Short-term collaborative visits are welcome for ongoing projects.
